PRODUCT OVERVIEW
Momcozy Wellness 1
Industry First* Warm-Massage Breast Pump
Momcozy Wellness 1 is a wearable breast pump built to make pumping feel warmer, gentler, and just easier to fit into real life.

KEY SELLING POINTS
Selling points, by priority
P0 messages must appear. P1 and P2 are selectable — choose one of each. P3 is optional.
Tier
Key message
What this means for moms
P0
Full-Surface Warmth
Three adjustable warmth levels cover the full flange-to-breast contact area, helping you feel more relaxed before pumping starts.
P0
5-Zone Suction-Synced Massage
Five massage zones pulse when the pump pulls and pause when it releases, instead of buzzing continuously throughout the session..
P1
DoubleFit™ Soft Dual-Layer Flange
The soft inner layer sits gently against your skin, while the supportive outer layer helps keep a steady seal as you move.
P1
Smart App Control
Start, pause, adjust suction levels, and log your milk output—all from your phone.
P1
Easy to Use
One-press release makes removal easier, and only five washable parts after use.
P2
Transparent Top & 6 oz Collector
The transparent top lets you check nipple alignment and milk flow without removing the pump, while the 6 oz collector supports longer sessions.
P2
Expert-Tuned Programs & Personalized Rhythm
Start with an expert-tuned program, then adjust warmth, massage, suction, and modes in the App and save your preferred rhythm.
P2
SoftPulse Baby-Like Suction
Small, steady micro pulses feel more like a baby’s natural suck—gentler on the breast, with up to 295 mmHg strength available when needed.
P3
Auto Shutoff
Massage stops automatically after 5 minutes and warmth after 15 minutes by default, so you do not need to keep checking the clock.
P3
Long Battery Use
Get up to 10 pumping-only sessions on one charge, or up to 6 with warmth and massage on, with massage noise below 50 dB.

YOUR AUDIENCE & CONTEXT
Who you’re speaking to
Everything in Part 2 assumes this context. If it does not match your channel, please let us know before you film.
THE CREATOR
Moms who have returned to work and pump during the workday — at a desk, in a lactation room, or between meetings.
WHAT TO SHOW
1
Product positioning for this creator type: the Warm-Massage Wearable Breast Pump designed to help working moms shift from workplace tension into a calmer, more manageable pumping routine — without putting the whole day on pause.
2
Show pumping inside a real workday, not a staged one. The interesting part is the transition — closing a laptop, finding twenty minutes, and coming back.
3
Keep it experience-led. Do not frame warmth or massage as stress relief, therapy, or a treatment for anything.

REASONS TO BELIEVE
Why each message is true
You do not need to recite these on camera. You do need to understand them, so your own words stay accurate.
Core message
Reason to believe
Transition more smoothly from work mode into pumping mode.
Warmth covers the full flange-to-breast contact area — not only a few isolated points — with 99°F, 102°F and 106°F settings for fast, even warming.
Warmth and surround rhythmic massage work together throughout the pumping session.
5-Zone Suction-Synced Massage uses gentle rhythmic vibration that activates during each pull and pauses on release, with 3 levels — not kneading or rolling motions. The massage follows the same rhythm as suction instead of vibrating continuously or randomly.
Feel more in control throughout the workday.
Adjust warmth, massage, suction and modes from the phone; choose an expert-tuned program or save a routine that works for you. You can also log milk output manually and review changes over time in the app.
Fit pumping more easily into a real workday.
One-press release, and only 5 milk-contact parts to wash. Up to 10 pumping-only sessions per charge, or up to 6 with warmth and massage active, with noise below 50 dB.
Spend less time readjusting before each session.
A transparent top helps you check nipple alignment and milk flow. The DoubleFit™ dual-layer flange combines soft, skin-friendly silicone contact with a more supportive, stable seal.

Guidelines & Delivery

PRODUCT USAGE & DO’S
How to use it on camera
Getting these wrong is the most common reason a video has to be reshot.
Product usage — safety
Remove the motor before pouring milk.
Flange accessories are not microwave-safe. Do not sterilize them in a microwave.
Please use the product as demonstrated in the instruction video (link :https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YLZGj2YY2e4.)
For your safety, do not use the breast pump while driving.
✓  Do’s
Use the full product name "Momcozy Wellness 1" each time you mention it.
Hold the product on camera so viewers can see what you are describing.
Rewrite the suggested lines in your own voice — accuracy matters, wording does not.
FTC Disclosure: clearly disclose sponsored content using #ad or Paid Partnership in a visible position within the content.
Must do in every post
Tag @momcozy_breastfeeding @momcozyofficial
Use hashtags: #wearablepumps #momcozybreastpump #pumpingmom #pumpingtips #ad / paid partnership
Please include a natural, non-salesy CTA at the end of the video, such as “Feel free to leave any questions in the comments” or “If you’re interested, check out the link in my bio to learn more.”  Please also add the product link below to your bio for tracking purposes:  [达人推广自行替换]

COMPLIANCE
Red lines — not negotiable
A video that crosses any of these cannot be published, and will have to be reshot.
✕
Do not claim or imply that Momcozy Wellness 1 can unclog, clear, or break up clogged milk ducts, relieve breast engorgement, treat, relieve, or prevent mastitis, increase milk supply, provide more complete emptying, guarantee faster let-down, or provide deep massage.
✕
Do not provide personalized medical advice. For persistent pain or discomfort, encourage viewers to consult a healthcare professional.
✕
Do not mention or compare competitor brands or products. You may only refer to “my old pump” or "pump I used before".
✕
Do not include alcohol, guns, violence, blood, or drugs.
✕
Do not show you are driving while pumping in front of camera
